latest_release.body:
## 🌟 Release Highlights

This release focuses on more reliable work-queue handling, hardened firewall/proxy egress, and sturdier session normalization across engines.

### ✨ What's New

- **Cancel obsolete work**: `cancel-work --obsolete` adds a read-only dry-run preview, and queue maintenance now cancels obsolete worker backlog.
- **Cost-aware model routing**: more workflows (including PR Sous Chef) use economy model routing instead of pinned models.
- **Skip-if-decision gates** added to ten more Copilot workflows and AWF engine invocations to cut unnecessary runs.
- **Name-based artifact upserts** in `update-issue`.
- **Strict dry-run compilation** now allows workflow steps.
- **Updated MCP Gateway to v0.5.6 and firewall to v0.29.11.**

### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements

- Hardened work queue launch recovery, stalled code-scanning fixer diagnostics, and deferred run binding to trusted worker activation.
- Proxy-routed provider APIs (Gemini, mini-SWE-agent bootstrap) are kept out of agent egress; OpenAI WIF detection hardened.
- Unified session fixes for Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Gemini, and Aider; structured tool results and workflow metadata are preserved.
- Copilot tool denials are classified and incomplete-workflow reports are deduplicated.
- Safe-output branch checks no longer require the Administration permission; terminal safe-output signals are now required.

### 📚 Documentation

- Verbatim Squad issue bootstrap prompt, fork PR/issue-template/runner-step guidance, and `obsolete_limit` debug playbook entries.
